# PEN-3713 — pin the GitHub egress wrappers to the front of the agent Job's PATH

`src/server/job-manifest.ts`, in `buildEnvVars()`: after the four env layers
collapse into `merged`, prepend `/usr/local/libexec/paperclip/bin` — the
root-owned directory the image now installs the GitHub egress wrappers into —
to `merged.PATH`, idempotently.

Why the adapter and not the chart. `paperclip.runtimePath` already fails the
Helm render when a wrapper directory is missing from PATH or lands after
`/usr/bin`, but that guard only renders onto the StatefulSet and the api
Deployment. An agent Job's PATH comes from layer 3 (`selfPod.inheritedEnv`) or
layer 4 (`adapterConfig.env.PATH`, an operator-set database value), and layer 4
is a flat last-writer-wins assignment with no shape check on any key. So the
invariant was enforced everywhere except the containers that actually run
agents.

Measured on a live agent pod 2026-10-02: `PATH` began
`/paperclip/opencode-api-key-bin:/paperclip/bin:…` and did not contain the
wrapper directory at all, so `git` resolved to `/usr/bin/git` and PEN-3156's
wrapper was off the traffic path — while the chart's render guard reported
healthy.

Prepend rather than reject: a malformed operator PATH is a misconfiguration
that would otherwise fail Jobs with nothing to do with GitHub, and the property
worth guaranteeing here is the ordering. When no PATH is present at all the
system default is used as the base, because emitting a lone directory would
clobber the image's own `ENV PATH` and leave nothing else resolvable.
